title: Ticking a 'None of these' checkbox must clear the other answers in its group even when each checkbox has its own name
summary: When symptoms are posted as separately named fields in one exclusive group, ticking 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' leaves the earlier symptoms ticked, so contradictory answers are submitted.
consumer: Author-written symptom checker form around the unchanged upstream checkboxes source at buggyCommit; upstream .mjs modules are saved byte-for-byte as .js and an import map redirects their .mjs relative imports.
